name: North Carolina

statute.readVia: web.archive.org snapshot of the official page (ncleg.gov returned 403); text includes S.L. 2025-47 amendments

windshield.strip: tint only along the top, not more than 5 in. below the top or below the AS1 line, whichever measurement is longer; untinted clear UV film allowed on the whole windshield

frontSide.note: total light transmission (window as tinted); a light-meter reading above 32% is conclusively presumed compliant; reflectance max 20%; nonreflective film

rear.note: same; rear window of a property-hauling vehicle exempt

backSide.note: windows behind the driver of a multipurpose vehicle (incl. minivans and pickup trucks) exempt from 35%/20% limits; still no red/yellow/amber, nonreflective

tint.measuredHow: total light transmission of the tinted window (film + glass), by a Commissioner-approved light meter

tolerance.cite: N.C. Gen. Stat. § 20-127(b)(1) (reading above 32% conclusively compliant)

tint.certificateOrSticker: Medical exception permit holders get a DMV sticker for the lower left-hand corner of the rear window (between glass and film); failure to display is a $200 infraction

medicalExemption.text: Medical exception permit for photosensitivity to visible light: written application to the DMV Drivers Medical Evaluation Program with the doctor's evaluation form; valid 5 years; max 4 permits at once; permit names the vehicle, windows and levels and must be carried in the vehicle; windshield rules apply without exception

penalty.text: Class 3 misdemeanor for driving with, or applying, non-compliant tint; defense if tint removed within 15 days with a DMV/Highway Patrol compliance certificate. Driver must roll down window when an officer approaches.

quotes: The total light transmission of the tinted window shall be at least thirty-five percent (35%). A vehicle window that, by use of a light meter approved by the Commissioner, measures a total light transmission of more than thirty-two percent (32%) is conclusively presumed to meet this restriction.
The light reflectance of the tinted window shall be twenty percent (20%) or less.
the tinting may not extend more than five inches below the top of the windshield or below the AS1 line of the windshield, whichever measurement is longer
A window of a multipurpose vehicle that is behind the driver of the vehicle. ... A minivan and a pickup truck are multipurpose vehicles.

helmet.conditions: All operators and passengers of motorcycles and mopeds (enclosed autocycles excepted); infraction $25.50 + costs

handheldPhone.noviceOrAgeBan: Under-18 provisional drivers: mobile phone restriction in G.S. 20-137.3 (not fully read)
handheldPhone.fineText: Texting/email: infraction, $100 + court costs, no points; school bus drivers Class 2 misdemeanor (min $100)

studdedTires.season: No seasonal limit; studs may project no more than 1/16 in. when compressed

radarDetector.note: No state ban found; commercial vehicles over 10,001 lb banned federally (49 CFR 392.71)

openQuestions: Content of S.L. 2025-47 changes to 20-127 not compared with prior text (likely tied to the 2025 end of NC safety inspections, which tint checks used to rely on)
Class 3 misdemeanor fine cap not read
